title: I put an AI written podcast in a game i'm making with AI
author: GTTGgames
selftext:
I wanted a video podcast that discussed what it meant to be an NPC and their thoughts on 'the player' who runs around their town. I had Fable write it based on some ideas I gave it and it's understanding of the game world (actual episode is 2+minutes with references to the stuff happening in town). It then synced up the script to the animations -roughly- and produced the audio.    
  
Each commercial also features the name of the shops in town (game worlds are randomized per player-diff shop names). The dev build of the game is on itchio [https://glitchthroughtheground.itch.io/myweirdlittletown](https://glitchthroughtheground.itch.io/myweirdlittletown)
